title.zh: 万事达卡与BVNK推出全球货币平台，整合法币与稳定币支付
title.en: Mastercard and BVNK Launch 'Global Money Platform' to Merge Fiat and Stablecoins

current_state.zh: Mastercard launched its Global Money Platform, its first major BVNK integration since acquiring the stablecoin infrastructure firm in August, letting businesses hold and convert stablecoins, issue stablecoin-linked cards, and settle payments into recipients' local bank accounts, with Nuvei and Marqeta among the first adopters.

updates.what_changed_zh: Mastercard and BVNK launched the Global Money Platform, a modular infrastructure layer enabling businesses to hold multi-currency fiat and stablecoin balances side by side, pay out via Mastercard Move, and spend stablecoin balances across Mastercard's merchant network, with Nuvei and Marqeta among the first integrators.
